purpose: Lets a person add pictures the way their device allows: take a photo with the camera, choose one or many from the device, or paste or drop them onto the page, and hands the app the picture files.
namedChanges: P1. the row is wrapped in the component PicturePickButtons({ onPick, words, multiple = false, disabled = false }); the two labels' words become words.takePhoto (Take photo) and words.choosePhoto (Choose photo) or, when multiple, words.choosePhotos (Choose photos)
P2. each onChange: void pick(e.target.files?.[0]) becomes onPick(pictureFiles(e.target.files)); e.target.value = "" stays, after it
P3. the Choose input gets multiple={multiple}; the Take photo input keeps capture="environment" and is never multiple
P4. disabled reaches both inputs and each label gets aria-disabled when disabled
picturePick.css holds only the rules for .btn, .btn.secondary, .btn.grow and .row (styles.css 87-90, 93, 98, 109) and the new .picture-drop-active rule
N1 pictureFiles, N2 usePictureDrop and N3 PictureDropZone are new (the source app had no paste or drop)

host.replaces: the call to the sheet's pick(), src/screens/PlantSheet.tsx:83,87 (pick() calls the app's makePictures step, which is not taken)
the literal words Take photo and Choose photo, src/screens/PlantSheet.tsx:82,86 (optional; English defaults)

library.title: Add picture (camera, choose, paste, drop)
library.note: Hands back the chosen files only and does not check the bytes; to shrink them take picture-shrink, to send them picture-upload.
